title: Formal Scope Waiver & Cryptographic Integrity Protection Decision for Ruff Format
summary: Formal repository owner approval granting an explicit scope waiver for 46 pre-existing historical and cryptographically pinned files from bulk ruff formatting, preserving package manifest seals and git blame history.

rationales.description: Critical verification scripts (including scripts/verify_public_v4_package.py) are sealed by SHA-256 hashes within the immutable distribution candidate ZIP (public_v4_candidate_20261003.zip, manifest 32f520c0db7cfdd3252103eff7910c504e92561faaf2cb273856dc24777c244c, core lock 8b1b3ea44b05). Reformatting these scripts would invalidate published cryptographic digests.

The remaining flagged files represent frozen historical artifacts and legacy development modules. Wholesale reformatting would disrupt fine-grained git blame forensics without functional or scientific benefit.
Code quality standards remain fully enforced via ruff check (linting) on all active and critical paths, passing with exit code 0 in CI and local verification.
